description: Renew a domain bought through handoff for one more year. Without max_price_usdc it only quotes: the price is the registrar's renewal price plus $3, rounded up to a whole dollar, and the answer says when the domain expires. With max_price_usdc it renews, and the agent's balance is charged only after the registrar confirms. handoff never renews on its own — call this before the expiry date.

agent_id.description: The agent that owns the domain and pays — you must control it

max_price_usdc.description: The most you agree to pay, in USDC — use price_usdc from the quote. Omit to get the quote only. If the price rose since, nothing is renewed and nothing is charged.

name: renew_domain
title: Renew a bought domain
